summary: Noah Holdings Ltd filed a 6-K announcing a final and a special dividend for FY2025: RMB 0.933 per share final dividend (approved June 11, 2026) and a separate special dividend (updated terms). The final dividend has ex-dividend date of July 8, 2026 (HK shares) or July 9, 2026 (ADSs), record date July 9, 2026, payment date July 30, 2026. The board declaration is disclosed; no advisor named. The mechanics note different ex-dividend dates for HK-listed ordinary shares vs NYSE-traded ADSs due to differing settlement cycles. Per-share amounts are in RMB; USD equivalent not stated. Watch for currency translation and potential ADS adjustment.
